2609.19213.title: Layer-wise Curriculum Learning for Efficient LLM Compression
2609.19213.paper_summary: In this paper, we introduce layer-wise curriculum learning for efficient LLM compression. The proposed method facilitates the knowledge transfer from the teacher model to the student model, utilizing a curriculum learning approach that begins with easier optimization tasks and progressively tackles harder ones. In order to adopt the layer-wise learning in LLM compression, we partition the whole model into multiple segments consisting of layers, thereby enabling more computationally efficient knowledge transfer for LLMs. Based on our theoretical analysis of cumulative error phenomenon, layer-wise curriculum learning accelerates convergence while stabilizing the knowledge transfer process. In addition, we present a feature caching method with a multi-threading strategy to efficiently address feature misalignment across layers, maximizing GPU utilization. Consequently, our method exhibits advanced model compression performance, as well as high computational efficiency in terms of minimized memory usage and short training hours. Experiments on multiple datasets show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing GPU memory usage and training hours by more than 50\% on BERT and GPT-2. Moreover, it outperforms the other pruning methods on LLaMA-family and Qwen models under the same training hours, with a lower GPU memory footprint.
2609.19213.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們介紹了層級課程學習以實現高效的 LLM 壓縮。所提出的方法促進了教師模型與學生模型之間的知識轉移，利用課程學習方法，從較簡單的優化任務開始，逐步解決更困難的任務。為了在 LLM 壓縮中採用層級學習，我們將整個模型劃分為多個由層組成的段，從而實現更具計算效率的知識轉移。根據我們對累積誤差現象的理論分析，層級課程學習加速了收斂，同時穩定了知識轉移過程。此外，我們提出了一種具有多線程策略的特徵緩存方法，以有效解決層之間的特徵不對齊問題，最大化 GPU 的利用率。因此，我們的方法展現了先進的模型壓縮性能，以及在最小化內存使用和縮短訓練時間方面的高計算效率。在多個數據集上的實驗顯示，所提出的方法在 BERT 和 GPT-2 上實現了最先進的性能，同時將 GPU 內存使用和訓練時間減少了超過 50%。此外，在相同的訓練時間內，它在 LLaMA 家族和 Qwen 模型上超越了其他剪枝方法，並且具有更低的 GPU 內存佔用。
